question.text:
Given below are two statements: Statements I:
IUPAC name of Compound \(A\) is 4-chloro-1,3-dinitrobenzene. Statements II:
IUPAC name of Compound \(\mathrm{B}\) is 4-ethyl-2-methylaniline. In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

solution.text:
IUPAC name $\begin{aligned} & \Rightarrow 1 \text {-chloro-2, 4-dinitrobenzene } \\ & \Rightarrow \text { statement-I is incorrect } \end{aligned}$
$\begin{aligned} & \Rightarrow \text { 4-ethyl-2-methylaniline } \\ & \Rightarrow \text { statement-II is correct }\end{aligned}$
